meta.interpretation: Built a intervention–intervention network from multiple myeloma trials starting 2022 or later.

visualization_rationale.reason: A network graph effectively visualizes the relationships and co-occurrence patterns between drugs in combination studies for multiple myeloma trials.

assumptions: Two interventions are linked when one trial lists both; edge weight is the number of such trials.
Only drug, biological and combination-product interventions are nodes; placebo and standard-of-care comparators are left out because they would link to everything.
Listing two drugs in one trial does not necessarily mean they were given together.

plan.chart_rationale: A network graph effectively visualizes the relationships and co-occurrence patterns between drugs in combination studies for multiple myeloma trials.
